chapters.reason: The paper proposes using special 'thinking tokens' as a uniform mechanism to allow the model to perform more calculations, fitting the definition of a single control signal for reasoning dynamics.
The approach relies on manipulating individual tokens (thinking tokens) to steer the reasoning process, which aligns with token-level reasoning control.
The use of thinking tokens to construct a solution over time implies a form of step-by-step internalization or iterative refinement of the reasoning process.
